Product Description

The cordless handset offers freedom of movement, allowing users to make and receive calls from anywhere within the phone's range without being tethered to a specific location. With the absence of cords, users can conveniently carry the handset around the house or office, enabling multitasking and flexibility during calls. This enhances user convenience and comfort, providing the flexibility to move around while staying connected.

Long Battery Life :-

The extended battery life of this cordless phone guarantees dependable use without the frequent need for regular recharging, allowing for continuous contact. The phone's long-lasting battery allows users to use it comfortably for longer periods of time without worrying about running out of power, which makes it perfect for busy homes or offices where continuous communication is crucial.

Superior Sound Quality :-

This phone employs advanced audio technology to ensure that voices come through crystal clear, free from any distortion or interference. This enhanced sound quality enhances the clarity and intelligibility of conversations, allowing one to hear every word with precision and accuracy.

Large LCD Display

Featuring a large LCD display with a 1.3 inch alphanumeric display, this phone provides clear and easily readable information, including caller IDs, time, and other important notifications.

Cordless Handset

The cordless handset offers freedom of movement, allowing users to make and receive calls from anywhere within the phone's range without being tethered to a specific location. With the absence of cords, users can conveniently carry the handset around the house or office, enabling multitasking and flexibility during calls.

Caller ID

This digital cordless telephone has a built-in Handset locator feature which helps you identify the your Handset. that allow you to make and receive calls from anywhere in your home.

Key features .

  • This cordless phone features a sleek and stylish frame which would definitely complement the interiors of your modern home
  • This cordless phone is easy to hold onto and you can receive and reject calls without any hassle
  • The LCD display screen and backlit feature shows incoming calls and it has an alphanumeric display
  • This cordless phone also has 50 Name Number Phonebook and the night mode features, helps you to identify numbers easily
  • The alphanumeric keypad allows you to operate and use this cordless phone more comfortably
  • This Panasonic cordless phone has one line support and seven ringer patterns to choose from
  • This cordless phone can also be mounted on the wall
